# Roadmap papers

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs_index.ps1. Regenerate it; never edit it by hand. -->

One file per paper, or per family of results, that the project may formalize next.
Target ids and their status come from [`frontier.toml`](../frontier.toml); a target id
without a status is in the Stage-79 frontier survey but not yet in the queue. Papers
marked *partly certified* also have a file in [`current/papers/`](../../current/papers/).

The Stage-79 frontier survey contained 35 target-result entries spanning 33 papers; its
introduction and search methodology remain in sections 5 and 6 of the archived
[`FORMALIZED_RESULTS_AND_LITERATURE_FRONTIER.md`](../../history/archive/FORMALIZED_RESULTS_AND_LITERATURE_FRONTIER.md).
